notes.title: Big Update 0.0.0.20
notes.content:
Good afternoon, here's a new update report on SCP Distorted Spacetime, version 0.0.0.20, which introduces several exciting new features and improvements.

Firstly, the game now features a Co-op Multiplayer mode, allowing players to team up with friends and navigate the mysterious and dangerous SCP Foundation facility together. This addition brings a whole new level of excitement and challenge to the game, as players must work together to overcome obstacles and avoid the deadly SCPs.

Another major addition is the inclusion of an animated SCP-914. The Clockworks now has a more detailed and realistic appearance, enhancing the overall immersion and atmosphere of the game.

Players can now also access the containment chamber of SCP-914, providing a deeper insight into the research and containment methods used by the SCP Foundation.

The game now includes an Inventory System, allowing players to keep track of keycards and documents that are essential for navigating the facility and progressing through the game.

Finally, a Blink System has been implemented, allowing players to avoid detection by certain SCPs that are sensitive to movement. This new mechanic adds an additional layer of strategy and tension to the gameplay.

Overall, version 0.0.0.20 of SCP Distorted Spacetime is a major update that improves the game in numerous ways. The addition of Co-op Multiplayer, the animated SCP-914, and the new Inventory System and Blink System are all significant improvements that will enhance the player's experience and keep them engaged in the game for longer periods of time.
